in_marathi.name: Amarsingh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amarsingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amara means Immortal and Singha means Lion. Amarsingh is a name for someone who embodies the courage and strength of a lion, and who is believed to be immune to death.

in_bengali.name: Amarsingh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Immortal Lion
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amarsingh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Amara means Immortal and Singha means Lion. Amarsingh is a name for someone who embodies the courage and strength of a lion, and who is believed to be immune to death.
